thread:
sara: seeing a big spike in requests to /v1/generate in us-central1, but scaler isn't adding GPU nodes. dashboards show queueing and proxy backpressure :warning:
jamal: can you paste the autoscaler metrics? desire vs current?
jamal: autoscaler-bot reports desire=18 current=6, provisioning_requests=12, last_provision_failure=IPAM_QUARANTINE (429)
infra-bot: alert: ipam-service returned 429 (quota/exceeded) for allocation attempts at 2026-03-18T14:10:23Z
michael: ugh IPAM again. any recent CIDR changes or new nodepool?
sara: we rolled a new gpu-nodepool w/ smaller CIDR yesterday, might be hitting allocation policy. kubectl logs from provisioner: "Failed to allocate ip: quota_exceeded"
lee: proxy metrics show envoy upstream queue depth skyrocketing: 120k queued, 5xx rate rising. health checks flapping for older pods behind the proxy.
carolina: how bad is the traffic spike? can we shift? we have spare capacity in eu-west1 and apac fallback.
jamal: we could shift 30% to eu-west1 as a quick mitigation. ops-runner-bot runbook suggests: `rctl traffic shift --from-region us-central1 --to-region eu-west1 --percent 30`
lee: also autoscaler is thrashing because nodes that do join fail initial health checks (proxy denies until ipam tags set). maybe bootstrapping script blocked by network policy.
michael: workaround: relax initial health check grace/window for gpu nodepool and let nodes warm up. Config patch snippet:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Config
spec:
  autoscaler:
    gracePeriodSeconds: 180
    scaleDownDelaySeconds: 300
```
jamal: if we patch that, autoscaler-bot will start marking new nodes healthy and kube-scheduler will place pods. but that will temporarily increase latency for cold nodes. cost spike risk noted.
sara: i'm going to run the traffic-shift and patch autoscaler. prepping command now. tagging @michael @lee for rollback conditions.
infra-bot: incident created INC-4123: "ipam quota causing scale-up lag + proxy backpressure" assigned to eng-infra oncall.
ops-runner-bot: executing traffic shift (dry-run) -> ok. executing now...
ops-runner-bot: traffic shift to eu-west1 30% completed in 90s. latency on eu-west1 is within SLOs.
jamal: patching autoscaler gracePeriod -> applying patch...
autoscaler-bot: patch applied, new gracePeriodSeconds=180
lee: seeing new nodes join, CNI tagging in progress. some nodes still stuck at "ip-assignment-pending" (ipam queue).
michael: for immediate relief, we can temporarily increase node CIDR pool by adding secondary pool to the nodepool. I'll run terraform apply to add a /22 extra pool (manual approval). this will take ~8-10m to provision. agree?
carolina: yes, do it. prefer adding pool over forcing IPAM override.
sara: approved. michael go ahead, keep us posted. we should also throttle non-prod traffic in us-central1 to reduce pressure.
michael: starting terraform apply now. logs: "creating nodepool-secondary... provisioning"
jamal: monitoring autoscaler metrics: desire trend moving down as nodes become available. proxy queue depth decreasing to 14k. 5xx rate stabilizing.
lee: healthchecks calmed, previously flapping pods now passing.
infra-bot: update INC-4123: mitigation steps in progress: traffic-shift, autoscaler-grace increase, added nodepool secondary.
sara: good job. follow-ups: 1) IPAM quota caps review with cloud infra, 2) add canary to autoscaler to avoid immediate thrash, 3) post-incident cost impact estimate. tagging @carolina for cost analysis.
carolina: will run cost delta query and post in #finance in 30m. initial guess +$6k/hr at peak if we kept force scale.
jamal: leaving this thread open until nodepool secondary fully active and queue depth <1k for 10m. current time ~ +7m.
ops-runner-bot: nodepool-secondary status: ACTIVE
jamal: last check: queue depth 420, 5xx back to baseline. autoscaler desire now 10, current 10.
sara: marking this as mitigated. will file a short postmortem. thanks team :thumbsup:
